items.Title: Guidewire BillingCenter Developer
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
5+ Years of GW Configuration experience
· Hands on GW Implementation Proficiency and Experience in GW Configuration Development
· Expertise configuring and developing several areas of BillingCenter including but not limited to – Account/Policy/Producer Handling, Various Plan Types, Billing Instructions, Charges, Charge Patterns, Charge Invoicing, Invoice Items, Direct/List/Agency Bill Processing, Premium Reporting, Holds and write-offs, Handling of Trouble Tickets/ Collaterals and Return Premium, Funds Tracking and Contacts.
· Robust understanding of BillingCenter DataModel
· Experience in GW Configuration Development (Expertise in GOSU, LOB Configuration, Rules Engine, Data Model, PCF, Wizards, Workflow and Activity)
· Experience with XML, GUnit, Jenkins, GIT/Subversion/TFS, Code Coverage and Code Scan Plugin/Tools
· Experience with Application Servers like WebSphere, Weblogic, JBoss and/or Tomcat
· Experience with Database Servers like SQL Server, Oracle, and/or DB2
· Good communication skills
· Insurance Industry and Domain Knowledge
